verdict.rationale: Adyen provides platform-level reconciliation reports and managed payouts (docs-5, docs-12) that the operator can use, but there is no evidence of a seller-facing self-serve portal, per-seller statements, or bookkeeper-ready exports that sellers can access directly without going through the ops user. missing for 10: seller-facing statement/export UI, evidence of self-serve access for sub-merchants, bookkeeper-specific export formats.
